results: 1. repetitive nerve stimulation: decremental response in facial and spinal accessory nerves
2. sustained upgaze fatigability test: 'PRONOUNCED PTOSIS' on counting 1 to 100 - the right eye closed completely while the left droop increased
4. neostigmine / edrophonium challenge: ptosis improved (partially right, completely left) with improvement in neck muscle power
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: AChR-antibody–positive generalized autoimmune myasthenia gravis (postsynaptic neuromuscular-junction disorder)

ALTERNATIVE: Lambert–Eaton myasthenic syndrome

ALTERNATIVE: Botulism

ALTERNATIVE: Ocular or bulbar myopathy causing fatigable ptosis (e.g., mitochondrial myopathy)
